remarks: Like a new home! This property is FULLY furnished and located in private Salem Straits Beach Association. Rebuilt by Fox Hill builders with impressive gourmet kitchen, heated pool and every imaginable amenity. Built-in Espresso maker? Yes! Move right in with gorgeous furniture throughout. Convenient flow of spaces and great views from living areas - especially main level with a walk-out to pool & expansive patio areas. Both uncovered and covered patio spaces for sun, swimming or outdoor dining & entertaining. 2 convenient Laundry Rooms on main and upper levels. Salem Straits residents have their own private beach, dock, storage for kayak, and a neighborhood to bike or run free. 2 blocks to private Salem Straits beach and dock. Also close to one of Darien's town beaches, Pear Tree Beach. Move right in Aug 1, with an all inclusive price of 45,000. Annual lease with tenant having additional costs, 35,000. month.
